videos.title: How Hyatt Cut Search Time for 250+ Human Agents with AI Copilot
videos.description:
Hyatt, a global hospitality company operating in more than 70 countries, uses NiCE CXone with Expert and AI-powered Copilot to solve a common customer service knowledge management problem: information exists across systems, but agents cannot access it quickly or confidently.

Before implementing this AI agent solution, Hyatt's customer service knowledge was scattered across disconnected systems, causing inconsistent search results, longer handle times, and inconsistent service quality.

NiCE CXone Expert restructured and tagged Hyatt's knowledge base for optimized search. NiCE Copilot, an AI-powered assistant for contact center agents, surfaces relevant information in real time during live customer interactions, guiding agents toward accurate responses.

Results: More than 250 Hyatt agents now use NiCE Copilot. Agents find answers faster, deliver more consistent support, and first contact resolution is improving.

videos.title: Bosch: Agentic AI Powers 90+ Agents Worldwide
videos.description:
Bosch, a global technology company with 400,000+ employees across 60 countries, replaced fragmented, region-by-region tools with a unified, AI-native approach to customer experience and operations. More than 90 AI agents and copilots now work alongside employees, adapting to dynamic workflows and handling complex service processes end-to-end.

The results? 90+ AI agents deployed across departments, 75%+ of customer interactions resolved by AI in some areas, and faster resolutions with less repetitive work for employees.

videos.title: Agentic AI Customer Service | Effortless Support, Real Business Results
videos.description:
Imagine customer service that resolves issues before customers even have to ask. NiCE CXone unites agentic AI and human agents on one platform, turning proactive support into measurable business results.

Agentic AI anticipates customer needs and resolves issues proactively, then hands off to live agents equipped with AI generated suggested responses for a seamless, human follow-up. NiCE data shows over 25 billion interactions, over 1 million agents, and more than 85% of Fortune 100 companies running on the CXone platform. Real customer outcomes follow, including one organization that combined 11 solutions into a single platform across 6,500 agents in 20 global offices. Other results include a 94% reduction in after call work, a 35% decrease in average handle time, and a 21.6% increase in agent productivity.

videos.title: Unified CX Platform | Avoid the Customer Breaking Point with One Connected System
videos.description:
Disconnected tools create disconnected experiences. Every handoff, delay, and repeated question pushes customers closer to their breaking point. See how NiCE replaces fragmented CX tools with one unified platform built for speed, context, and resolution.

Organizations that rely on disconnected point solutions, such as routing, CRM, knowledge, and analytics, create blind spots for agents, longer resolution times, and customers approaching their breaking point. NiCE's unified customer experience platform brings data, workflows, and AI into a single system, giving agents full context, automating repetitive work, and helping teams avoid that breaking point altogether. Key themes: customer experience platform, CX consolidation, contact center technology, agent efficiency, AI powered customer service, unified customer data.
